---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## Summary

One-sentence description of the feature.

## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve? Who benefits and when?

## Proposed solution

How do you imagine this working in the app? If it has UI, sketch the flow
or mock it up. If it is backend-only, describe the behavior.

## Use case

Concrete example of when you would use this and what the outcome should be.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why the proposed solution is better.

## Possible implementation

Optional: if you have ideas about how this could be built (affected files,
libraries, edge cases to handle), list them here.

## Additional context

Related issues, screenshots from other apps, links, etc.
